'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***One person is killed and 23 others are injured by a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Kalibr (missile family)|Kalibr missile]] strike in [[Mykolaiv]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2023/04/27/ukraine-war-one-dead-and-over-20-injured-in-russian-missile-attack-on-mykolaiv (Euronews)]
*[[Ethiopian civil conflict (2018–present)|Ethiopian civil conflict]]
**[[Assassination of Girma Yeshitila]]
***[[Girma Yeshitilla]], the leader of the [[Amhara Region|Amhara]] [[Prosperity Party]], the ruling party in [[Ethiopia]], is shot dead by unknown gunmen in [[North Shewa Zone (Amhara)|North Shewa]], [[Amhara Region]]. [https://borkena.com/2023/04/27/girma-yeshitila-top-ethiopias-ruling-party-official-assassinated/ (Borkena)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**An attack on a [[Burkina Faso Armed Forces|Burkinabé]] [[military base]] in [[Burkina Faso]]'s [[Est Region (Burkina Faso)|Est region]] by [[jihadist]]s kills 33 Burkinabé soldiers. During the attack, the soldiers say they killed 40 of the jihadists before government reinforcements arrived. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/28/attack-on-burkina-faso-military-post-kills-at-least-33-soldiers (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Three people are killed by a [[suicide bomber]] in [[Lakki Marwat]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-militant-attack-kills-three-troops-officials-say-2023-04-28/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy|Iranian Navy]] seizes a [[Marshall Islands]]-flagged [[oil tanker]] in [[international waters]] of the [[Gulf of Oman]], according to the [[United States Navy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-navy-oil-tanker-advantage-057155f4d9caf92131533fe90f94a3a0 (AP)]
*One person is injured after multiple bombings in [[Weare, New Hampshire|Weare]], [[New Hampshire]], [[United States]]. The perpetrator is still at large. [https://www.nbcboston.com/news/local/police-investigation-shuts-roads-in-weare-nh/3031813/ (WBTS-TV)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Cortes Generales|Parliament]] votes to ban the decades-old tradition of "[[bullfighting]] with [[costume]]d [[Dwarfism|dwarfs]]" in line with "[[European Union|EU]] Directives concerning [[discrimination]] against [[people with disabilities]]". This decision is welcomed by disability organizations. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/apr/27/spain-bans-decades-long-tradition-of-dwarf-bullfighting?utm_source=ground.news&utm_medium=referral (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Prime Minister of Poland]], [[Mateusz Morawiecki]], officially re-opens the [[Warsaw Radom Airport]] in [[Radom]], which has been under renovation since May 2019. It is estimated that the airport in its current form will initially be able to serve around 1 million passengers per year, and in the future around three million passengers per year. [https://polishnews.co.uk/warsaw-radom-airport-ceremonial-opening-when-is-the-first-flight-airport-history-kalendarium/ (Polish News)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Karachi Express train fire]]
**At least seven people are killed by a fire on a [[train car]] in [[Khairpur District]], [[Sindh]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/passenger-train-fire-pakistan-children-missing-9960e4195ed27db9d9a0814cbe11b802 (AP)]
*[[2023 Alaska mid-air collision]]
**Three [[United States Army]] personnel are killed and another is injured when two [[AH-64 Apache]] helicopters collide over [[Healy, Alaska|Healy]], [[Alaska]], near [[Fort Wainwright]], in the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/three-dead-after-us-army-helicopters-crash-central-alaska-wpost-2023-04-28/ (Reuters)]

*Eleven people are killed and one person is missing when a [[boat]] [[capsize]]s in the waters off [[Indonesia|Indonesia's]] western [[Provinces of Indonesia|province]] of [[Riau]]. [https://www.dailyfinland.fi/worldwide/32156/11-killed-9-missing-as-boat-capsizes-in-Indonesia?utm_source=ground.news&utm_medium=referral (''Daily Finland'')][https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-11-dead-after-indonesia-ferry-capsizes-2023-04-28/ (''Reuters'')]
*At least 23 houses are severely damaged by a magnitude 5.2 earthquake in [[Bajura District]], [[Nepal]]. [https://www.reportersnepal.com/2023/04/793782 (ReportersNepal)]

'''International relations'''
*In a resolution drafted by the [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]] and [[Japan]], the [[UN Security Council]] unanimously condemns the [[Taliban]] [[Leadership Council of Afghanistan|administration's]] ban on [[Afghan people|Afghan]] [[Women in Afghanistan|women]] working, including for the [[United Nations]] in [[Afghanistan]], and calls on Taliban leaders to lift the ban immediately. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20230428-un-security-council-unanimously-condemns-taliban-s-crackdown-on-women-s-rights?utm_source=ground.news&utm_medium=referral (France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Human rights in Russia]]
**The [[Moscow City Court]] orders the closure of the [[SOVA Center]], which monitored [[Russian nationalism|nationalist]] and [[racism in Russia|racist]] movements in [[Russia]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/04/27/moscow-court-orders-closure-of-sova-analytical-center-a80969 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Women in the military]]
**The [[Ministry of Defense (Saudi Arabia)|Ministry of Defense]] of [[Saudi Arabia]] begins the [[recruitment]] of [[Women's rights in Saudi Arabia|women]] for the [[Armed Forces of Saudi Arabia|military]], allowing both genders to join for the first time. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/saudi-arabia/2023/04/26/Saudi-Arabia-s-defense-ministry-opens-applications-for-military-jobs-for-both-genders (Al Arabiya)]
